title: Hera probe gets 1st good look at asteroid system clobbered by NASA's DART mission | Space photo of the day for Nov. 6, 2026
caption:
The Hera probe is finally revealing the true damage caused by humanity's first intentional asteroid collision. By mapping the craters and debris on Didymos, we're learning exactly how to defend Earth from future threats.
